slides.texte_overlay:
It took me 10 years to
understand this. I'll explain
it in 2 minutes:

1. Nobody is thinking about
your mistakes as much as you.

2. Your habits decide your
future more than your goals.

3. Your parents did their best
with what they had.
Let it go.

4. Comfort feels safe.
It's also where years disappear.

5. The right people make you
better without trying.

6. A curious mind never
gets old. Learn something
small every day.
